**Kit-fit checklist** — the kit is small on purpose; a good proposal:
- [ ] solves a real Windows/WSL2 dev-environment pain
- [ ] keeps the surface small (no orchestration/k8s/CI-platform features)
- [ ] fits the mutation policy (dry-run + consent + teardown reversibility)
- [ ] would be covered by the existing test patterns or adds its own suite
